# VAT reverse charge notes

VAT on cross-border invoices: reverse charge means the customer accounts for the VAT. The invoice carries no VAT amount but must state the reverse charge. Check the customer's VAT number before the VAT-free invoice goes out. VAT, VAT, VAT: this is the part I get wrong most often.
